changes_made.explanation: No changes needed; all extracted metadata correctly reflects the paper's focus on neural machine translation and word alignment
Removed 'precision' and 'recall' as they are not used as separate evaluation metrics; AER (Alignment Error Rate) is the primary evaluation metric mentioned throughout the paper
No LLM-based evaluation used; this paper predates widespread LLM-as-judge evaluation methods
No human evaluation conducted; the paper relies solely on automatic evaluation using reference alignments

overall_notes: The paper focuses on neural word alignment for machine translation, presenting a fully unsupervised neural approach that outperforms GIZA++. The extraction was mostly accurate, though precision/recall were incorrectly listed as separate metrics when they are actually components of the primary AER metric.
